name: Discover Our Town

sources.title: Add Your Listing form — name/email, business name, category (lodging/dining/attractions/shops/events/business directory/etc.), full address, phone, website, Facebook, Twitter, optional promo code, description

requirements: US local-business fit — categories are lodging, dining, attractions, specialty shops, artists, entertainment/events, recreation, organizations, business directory, transportation, relocation, real estate, health & wellness
Physical NAP details required: street address, city, state, zip, phone — a map marker must be placed/dragged to the business location
A 'Promo Code (if applicable)' field hints a paid/premium tier exists, but the base form has no payment step
preparation: Business name, address, city/state/zip, phone, toll-free number
Website URL, Facebook page, Twitter handle
workflow: Fill all required fields and drag the map marker onto the business location
Pick the best category ('Business Directory' may be the only vaguely plausible slot for non-local products — but forcing a SaaS here is a stretch)
Submit; expect manual review typical of legacy directories
watchFor: HTTP-only form (no TLS) — don't submit anything sensitive through it
Promo-code field suggests hidden paid tiers; the free listing is the default path
Legacy site design — unclear how actively it is maintained
A remote software product with no US physical location does not belong here; forcing it produces a junk citation
countsAsLive: The business appears browsable/searchable on discoverourtown.com in its city/state category
unknowns: Whether submissions are still reviewed — site shows legacy-era design
What the promo code unlocks (likely enhanced placement)
